<details>
This is a .SRCINFO metadata file for the megacmd-bin AUR package. .SRCINFO files are non-executable metadata generated by `makepkg --printsrcinfo` that describe package properties such as dependencies, sources, checksums, and PGP keys. They contain no executable code and cannot perform any operations on their own.

The package sources point to the legitimate upstream MEGA repository (https://mega.nz/linux/repo/Arch_Extra/), which is the expected location for prebuilt MEGAcmd binaries. The package includes a PGP signature source and declares a validpgpkeys entry (B01C811880480C854C73EC7E1A664B787094A482), indicating cryptographic verification is intended. Two files have SHA256 checksums provided; the LICENSE local source has `sha256sums = SKIP`, which is standard practice for local files in AUR packages.

There is nothing suspicious in this file — no obfuscated code, no unexpected network requests, no file operations, and no dangerous commands. All content is consistent with ordinary AUR packaging metadata.
</details>
